extracted.intended_audience: local independent news publishers and entrepreneurs in the U.S. & Canada; prospective LION members and supporters
extracted.subtask_description: Resources, programs, awards, and membership benefits designed to help independent local news organizations become and remain sustainable businesses. The page summarizes offerings (audits, stages, grants, training, community) rather than giving full procedural criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a sustainable news business
rubrics_metrics.description: What does it mean to be a sustainable news business? Read our definition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page links to LION's working definition of sustainability for news businesses. The homepage only prompts readers to 'read our definition' — the actual criteria/definition live on the linked resource and are not included on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: LION's Stages of Sustainability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refers to a staged framework LION uses to describe organizational progress toward sustainability. The homepage mentions the framework but does not provide the stage descriptions or evaluation criteria here; follow the linked page for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability Audit (report and service)
rubrics_metrics.description: Read our latest Sustainability Audit report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates LION produces audit reports used to assess sustainability. The homepage highlights the audit as a resource; the specific metrics, methodology, and scoring used in the audit are contained in the report itself (not shown on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: LION Publishers Sustainability Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are now open for the 2026 LION Publishers Sustainability Awards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An awards program recognizing sustainable news organizations. The homepage announces the call for applications and an open call for judges, but does not publish the award criteria or judging rubric here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member benefits categories
rubrics_metrics.description: LION members receive exclusive benefits as they build and develop sustainable news businesses: Community, Recognition, Education, Events, Funding, Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These six categories represent the core dimensions of value LION offers members and can be read as high-level desiderata for what membership should deliver. Detailed descriptions of benefits/services under each category are on linked membership pages, not fully detailed here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weekly newsletter (tip sheet)
rubrics_metrics.description: Weekly tip sheet on independent news — Sign up for LION's newsletter to get funding opportunities, small business tips, and other resources for independent news publishers delivered to your inbox.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsletter is presented as an ongoing resource for publishers to receive practical opportunities and advice. The homepage describes its purpose and signup but does not enumerate newsletter selection criteria or content cadence beyond 'weekly tip sheet.'

rubrics_metrics.name: LION-GNI Audit service (as a member offering)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The LION-GNI Audit, as a service, is something we would not know how to obtain elsewhere and will likely mark a significant milestone in our ability to grow and sustain our organization." (testimonial)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Testimonial cites the audit service as a distinctive member offering that helps organizational growth and sustainability. The homepage uses this to signal the audit's practical value; methodology/details remain on service pages or reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: LION-GNI Boot Camp (training & coaching)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The LION-GNI Boot Camp has been pivotal to the development of my media startup and my growth as a founder. The instruction is enlightening; the coaching is propelling; the access to resources, generous; and the community is both inspiring and supportive." (testimonial)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Boot Camp is presented as an educational/coaching program for founders and startups. The homepage highlights outcomes (instruction, coaching, resources, community) through testimonial text; full curriculum, selection, and evaluation criteria are on program pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding programs and grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcements such as 'LION announces 15 members selected for Growth Grants' and references to philanthropy and revenue streams
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage signals that LION runs or publicizes funding and grant programs (e.g., Growth Grants) and tracks revenue-source trends (philanthropy vs. advertising). Specific eligibility, selection criteria, and reporting requirements are not provided on the homepage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational support (HR & financial management help)
rubrics_metrics.description: LION seeks 40 nonprofit local publishers who need HR and financial management support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates LION facilitates operational support programs (HR and financial management) to help member organizations become more sustainable. Details about program scope, selection, and deliverables are on the linked opportunity page rather than on the homepage.
